# Strata Kit

> Strata Kit is a renderer-neutral TypeScript library for deterministic procedural
> layering in 3D space: seeded noise, signed-distance composition, terrain fields,
> surface-map bakes, scalar relief profiles, and optional Three.js/R3F adapters.

## Use the package

- Install: `pnpm add strata-procedural`.
- ESM package; supports Node.js 22 and newer.
- Import only from `strata-procedural` or its documented exports: `noise`, `sdf`,
  `terrain`, `materials`, `shaders`, `surface-fields`, `three`, and `r3f`.
- The root through `surface-fields` are renderer-neutral. `three` and `r3f` require
  their optional peer dependencies.
- Every random result derives from an explicit string or finite numeric seed. Do not
  introduce `Math.random` or rely on random-draw order without treating it as a
  compatibility change.

- [README](https://github.com/jbcom/strata-kit/blob/main/README.md): installation and
  runnable terrain, surface-bake, and scalar-relief examples.
- [API reference](https://github.com/jbcom/strata-kit/blob/main/docs/API.md): public
  imports, exported symbols, output layouts, input rules, and adapter contracts.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jbcom/strata-kit/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md):
  module boundaries, determinism contract, data ownership, and intentional limits.
- [Procedural modernization](https://github.com/jbcom/strata-kit/blob/main/docs/PROCEDURAL_MODERNIZATION.md):
  a proposal for future extraction work and current source evidence; it is not an API
  reference and does not extend the current API.
- [Provenance](https://github.com/jbcom/strata-kit/blob/main/docs/PROVENANCE.md):
  source and licensing evidence for the library's procedural work.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/jbcom/strata-kit/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): local
  setup and verification.
- [Agent guide](https://github.com/jbcom/strata-kit/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository
  invariants for automated contributors.
